title: Assessment suite
description: The caller's questions. PanGloss validates and executes a suite exactly as supplied; it never authors a case, edits an expectation, or moves one between statuses.

suiteId.description: Opaque and caller-issued. PanGloss never parses it.

metadata.description: Unknown caller metadata. Carried verbatim and included in the suite digest.

cases.description: Authoritative order. Two cases may share a surface form and remain distinct, because a case is a question the caller is asking, not a word.

caseId.description: The only join key between two runs. Unique within a suite.

supersedes.description: Baseline case IDs this case replaces. PanGloss follows a declared link and never infers one.

sourceReferences.description: Opaque to PanGloss: shape and size are validated, contents are carried or omitted exactly as supplied.

expectation.description: required, forbidden and allowed must be pairwise disjoint: an identity both demanded and banned has no satisfiable reading.

status.description: Recorded, never created or transitioned by PanGloss. Only `adjudicated` is evaluable.

closedWorld.description: true with empty required and allowed is the encoding for "this form is ungrammatical": it is satisfied only by a complete empty analysis set.
